## Init Hardening for External Projects

### Problem

`lisa init` was built and tested on the lisa project itself. An external
project may hit edge cases: missing directories, wrong rdspi-workflow path,
incomplete idle hook setup, CLAUDE.md template that references lisa-specific
paths. `lisa validate` needs to catch these before the user wastes time on
`lisa loop`.

### Requirements

#### 1. Verify generated files are correct
Run `lisa init` on a clean temp directory (simulating a fresh project) and
verify:
- `.claude/settings.local.json` is generated with correct `idle_prompt` hook
  pointing to `.lisa/hooks/on-idle.sh`
- `.lisa/hooks/on-idle.sh` exists and is executable
- `.lisa/.gitignore` includes `signals/`
- `docs/knowledge/rdspi-workflow.md` exists (or wherever the workflow is
  placed) and matches the embedded content
- `CLAUDE.md` template does NOT contain lisa-specific references
- Directory structure is created: `docs/active/tickets/`, `docs/active/stories/`,
  `docs/active/work/`

#### 2. Validate catches common mistakes
`lisa validate` should catch and report clearly:
- Missing `docs/knowledge/rdspi-workflow.md` (or configured workflow path)
- Missing `.claude/settings.local.json` or missing idle_prompt hook in it
- Missing `.lisa/hooks/on-idle.sh` or not executable
- Tickets with `type: ticket` instead of valid values (task/bug/feature/spike/chore)
- Tickets with invalid `phase` values
- Tickets referencing `depends_on` IDs that don't exist
- Empty ticket directory (warning, not error)

#### 3. CLAUDE.md template quality
The generated CLAUDE.md should:
- Include project name and detected type (Rust/Node/Go/Python)
- Reference the correct rdspi-workflow.md path
- Include build/test commands detected from the project
- NOT include any lisa-internal references

### Acceptance Criteria

- `lisa init` on a clean directory produces all required files
- `lisa validate` reports actionable errors for each failure case above
- CLAUDE.md template is project-appropriate for at least Rust and Node projects
- `cargo test --workspace` passes with new/updated validation tests
